evidence: the overall aim of this work was to identify isopeptides between TG2 and synthetic CD-active gluten peptides in different model systems.

evidence: The model reaction of TG2 (0.32 nmol/L) with PepQ was performed in Tris-HCl buffer (0.1 mol/L, pH 7.4, 10 mmol/L CaCl2) at a molar ratio of TG2:PepQ of 1:150 at 37 °C for 120 min.

attributes.route_or_context: simultaneous addition of the three different peptides P1, P2, and P3
evidence: The model reaction of TG2 was repeated with the simultaneous addition of the three different peptides P1, P2, and P3.

To study which lysine residues were preferred binding sites, TG2 was incubated with different ratios of PepQ (1:50; 1:10; 1:1; 10:1)

sample_scopes.detail: recombinant human TG2 and synthetic gluten peptides

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data-dependent acquisition (DDA) was used on a Q Exactive HF, and label-free quantification (LFQ) was performed by comparing peak areas across different molar ratios.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment specifically targets Nε-(γ-glutamyl)-lysine isopeptide crosslinks between TG2 and gluten peptides, using pLink2 and a reciprocal MaxQuant search strategy.
